'''Fang''' was a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-skinned, brown-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], tame [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, the rancor was offered for sale as a pet by the [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] [[80-T5]], who sold a wide range of goods from a small stall located within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] Fang was offered for sale, the rancor was a far smaller size than the normal height of a fully grown rancor, standing at about shoulder height next to an adult [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="CWO" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It isn't the size of the Rancor in the fight, it's the size of the fight in the Rancor.|The store description of Fang|<ref name="CWO" />}}
Fang first appeared as a purchasable companion for players in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] released by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment in [[2010]]<ref name="CWO" /> and shut down in [[2014]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=2014-01-24|language=English|archivedate=20140127193845}}</ref> The rancor could be bought for 500 station cash, a premium in-game currency players had to buy with real money. Given that Fang's purchase was entirely optional, this article makes no assumptions about if it was bought.<ref name="CWO" />
